title: Groove and Cam
subtitle: The fifth and seventh Degrees
text: Personally grind and apply a pattern. At D5 with active blood, the Artificer offers a free Precision Governor Kit; crafted or gifted kits work without claiming, but cannot replace practice. On a Greater working floor, seat the complete, aligned Forge two blocks behind the Focus. Plant your Staff, fill four anchors, seal the daemon, close two 250 mL circuits, then finish the procession. Six lit braziers take the kit, Grindstone, Honeycomb, Amethyst Shard, Wax Cylinder, and Hematic Iron Block. Precision records a chosen enchantment or curse. Personally grind a chosen vibration; at D7 you may use the Master Cam Kit without accepting the earlier gift. Enduring Pattern uses the same layout, eight anchors, three 250 mL circuits, and the cam, Anvil, Netherite Scrap, Mnemonic Ambergris Block, Chalybeate Sclerite, and Suspended Blood Crystal. Masterwork stabilizes cylinders. Tiers survive moving; cancellation returns offerings and Staff, not spent blood.
